name: argus-tracking-script
description: Argusmetrics tracking script - privacy-first analytics. Single source (src/tracker.js); `npm run build` minifies and syncs the artifact everywhere it is served from.

scripts.build: terser src/tracker.js --config-file terser.config.json -o dist/tracker.min.js && npm run sync
scripts.size: wc -c src/tracker.js dist/tracker.min.js && gzip -c dist/tracker.min.js | wc -c
